content.text: Ka capa, kaie kâlawk hah pahnim hanh.
Kaie kâpoelawknaw hah na lung dawk pâkuemh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, hote ni na hringsawnae hoi
roumnae na thap sin han.
Lungmanae hoi lawkkatang ni na cettakhai hanh naseh.
Na lahuen dawk awi nateh, na lungthin dawkvah thut haw.
Hottelah Cathut hoi tami hmalah,
minhmai kahawi na hmu vaiteh, tawmrasang lah na o han.
Na lungthin buem hoi BAWIPA kâuep nateh,
nama e thaipanueknae hah kângue hanh.
Na lamthung pueng dawk ama na panuek haw,
na lamthung pueng dawk na hrawi han.
Namahoima lungkaang lah kâsak hanh.
BAWIPA hah taket nateh yon cettakhaih.
Na takthai hanelah damnae lah ao vaiteh,
na hru hanelah thasainae lah ao han.
Na tawnta e naw hoi aluepawnaw hoi
BAWIPA hah bari haw.
Hahoi na capai dawk a kawi vaiteh,
misur katinnae tangkom dawk misur katha hoi a kawi han.
Ka capa, BAWIPA yuenae hah dudam hanh.
Na phep e hai hmuhma hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na pa ni a lungpataw e capa teh
ouk a yue e patetlah,
BAWIPA ni a lungpataw e naw hah ouk a yue.
Lungmanae kahmawtnaw teh a lung kahawi e tami lah ao awh teh,
Thaipanueknae ka tawn e tami hai a lung kahawi e tami lah ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ngun pungdaw sak e hlak,
lungmanae pungdaw sak e hah ahawihnawn.
Talungpaling hlak hai aphu ao teh,
na ngai e pueng ni hai phat hoeh rah.
Aranglae kut dawk hringsawnae ao teh,
avoilah e kut dawk hnopai hoi barinae ao.
A lamthung teh lamthung kanawm lah ao teh,
a lamthung pueng teh roumnae lah ao awh.
Kakuennaw hanelah hringnae thingkung lah ao teh,
ka hringkhaie pueng teh tami lung kahawi e lah ao awh.
BAWIPA ni lungangnae lahoi talai hah a kangdue sak teh,
thaipanueknae lahoi kalvan a cak sak.
A panuenae lahoi talî a kapek teh,
tâmai ni tadamtui a bo sak.
Ka capa, lungangnae katang hoi
panuethainae hah kuen nateh,
na mit hoi kâhlat sak hanh.
Hottelah pawiteh, na muitha hanelah hringnae lah awm vaiteh,
na lahuen hanelah pahrennae lah ao han.
Hottelah na lamthung dawk karoumcalah na cet vaiteh,
na khok na kamthui mahoeh.
Na i navah na taket mahoeh,
ihmu katuilah na i han.
Taki ka tho e kaluekalapnae hai taket hanh.
Hoehpawiteh, tamikathoutnaw ni
a kâhmo awh e runae hai taket hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA teh na kânguenae lah awm vaiteh,
na khok teh karap dawk hoi a hlout sak han.
Sak nahane kâ na kut dawk ao nahlangva,
hmu hanelah kakamcunaw hah
hnokahawi pasoung laipalah awm hanh.
Poe hane na sin nahlangva, cet ei, bout tho lah a,
tangtho torei na poe han, telah na imri koe tet pouh hanh.
Na imri taranlahoi thoenae sak hanelah kâcai hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nang na ka ring e doeh.
Nang dawk patawnae na poe hoeh pawiteh,
a khuekhaw awm laipalah tami taran hanh.
Tami rep kacoungroenaw e hnopai noe awh hanh.
Ahnimae lamthung hai rawi awh hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a lungthin ka longkawi e teh
BAWIPA hanelah panuet a tho teh, a lungthin kalan e teh,
ama hoi arulahoi kâponae ao.
Tamikathoutnaw e im dawk,
BAWIPA thoebonae ao, hatei,
tamikalannaw e im teh, yawhawi a poe.
Dudam lahoi kaawmnaw hah a dudam teh,
ka kârahnoumnaw hah pahrennae a poe.
Tami lungkaang ni bawilennae râw a coe han.
Hatei, tamipathunaw ni a coe awh e râw teh, kayanae doeh.
